topic: The episode so disturbing it triggered mass seizures across multiple countries
hook: One episode triggered mass seizures across multiple countries.
script: One episode triggered mass seizures across multiple countries. Beyond the Pokémon incident, the anime series Yu-Gi-Oh had an episode pulled in 2000 after photosensitive animation caused viewer discomfort reported across Japan, South Korea and parts of Europe simultaneously. The episode featured a card game sequence with alternating high-contrast patterns at dangerous frequencies. It has never been re-aired anywhere in the world.
